properties.text: A transient, auto-dismissing message presented by the host via ActionUIModel.presentToast. It auto-dismisses, queues rapid posts, and can carry one inline action. On Android it shows as a native bottom Material snackbar (on Apple it is a top banner). Triggering it from a button is only for the demo - a toast is for events that happen without direct user action.
Tap a button to post a toast. Undo feedback appears here.
